$comment: Technical debt register — M0.5 WP8. Seeded from docs/m0/M0-Technical-Debt-Prioritization.md and docs/blueprint/J-technical-debt.md. Machine-readable source for docs/dashboards/Technical-Debt.md.

items.title: Tier claims were provider-name shorthand
items.impact: Product asserted a sync capability it cannot perform.

items.title: No automated test or certification harness
items.impact: Milestone Definition of Done was unprovable.

items.title: Certification profiles were prose, not runnable configuration
items.impact: No measurement could be attributed to a named profile.

items.title: No Measured Baseline for most C4 metrics
items.impact: Certified Thresholds cannot be set for unmeasured metrics.

items.title: PROF-08 voice profile unsupported — no LiveKit test project
items.impact: Every voice certification row is blocked and can never roll up as pass.

items.title: PROF-03 packet-loss profile unsupported
items.impact: Degraded-network behaviour is unmeasured in every engine.

items.title: Analytics events are not schema-validated at emission
items.impact: Malformed events reach the store undetected.

items.title: Po planning behaviour has no certification coverage
items.impact: Clarification precedence in ADR-008 is unverified.

items.title: Room capacity enforcement is asserted server-side only
items.impact: Client-side capacity messaging can drift from server truth.

items.title: Accessibility certification is an automated subset only
items.impact: WCAG 2.1 AA cannot be claimed from the automated sweep alone.

items.title: Chat and Moderation engines are unimplemented
items.impact: Two Constitution engines have no module mapping.

items.title: Lint warning cap raised to 25 to make the gate green
items.impact: Warning debt is tolerated rather than removed.
